title: Noir (film) — Overview
text:
Title: Noir (film) — Overview

Noir is a 2015 Canadian drama film directed by Yves Christian Fournier. An ensemble cast film set primarily in the impoverished Montreal
 North area, the film focuses on a variety of interconnected storylines. Characters include Dickens (Kémy St-Eloi) and Bobby (Clauter Alexandre), 
 two Haitian Canadian brothers involved in the gang lifestyle; Kadhafi (Salim Kechiouche), an Algerian immigrant who works in a dry cleaning
  shop with Jean-Jacques (Benz Antoine) and dreams of becoming a hip hop star; and Suzie (Jade-Mariuka Robitaille), a stripper in a relationship with drug dealer Evans (Christopher Charles) while simultaneously connected in an ambiguous way to Phil (Patrick Hivon). Kechiouche garnered a Jutra Award nomination for Best Supporting Actor at the 18th Jutra Awards.
